about: The Bock casemates as galleries, for the tunnel view (v2/docs/specs/tunnel-view.md) and the landmark cutaways. This is an approximate hand model to be reviewed, not a survey: only the numbers under 'published' come from a source; every position and height is an assumption (listed below) placed against the scene's terrain. The transport graph already holds the casemates' visitor passages as OpenStreetMap maps them (path tunnels, drawn by the tunnel view on their own); this file adds the main gallery and its gun branches as rooms.
name: Bock casemates (Casemates du Bock)
status: approximate hand model, to be reviewed by the owner against the published plan

format.crs: LUREF (EPSG:2169) metres, as the scene; heights in metres above sea level, as the scene's terrain
format.gallery: id; kind (gallery or branch); width_m and height_m of its box; en: the centre line of its floor, [[E, N], ...]; z: the floor's height, one number (level) or one per point; ends: 'open' or 'closed' at the first and last point
format.rule: the top of every gallery (z + height_m) stays at least 1 m under the terrain over its whole width (check X7)

published.main_gallery: 110 m long, up to 7 m wide
published.gun_emplacements: 25 in side branches: 12 facing north (Pfaffenthal, Clausen), 13 facing south (Grund)
published.other: about 1,100 m2 in all; several storeys in the rock; a well 47 m deep; embrasures open in the cliff faces
sources: research/03-underground-tunnels/README.md#bock (Luxembourg City Tourist Office page and leaflet, en.wikipedia 'Bock (Luxembourg)', showcaves.com)

assumptions: Place: the main gallery runs along the middle of the promontory's plateau, on the bearing of the passages OpenStreetMap maps there (17.4 degrees north of east), where the terrain leaves the most rock over a level gallery 110 m long.
Level: one floor at 276.6 m, the height the transport graph gives the mapped passages in the middle of the promontory. The real casemates have several storeys; only this one is modelled.
Section: main gallery 4 m wide and 3.5 m high (published: up to 7 m wide); branches 2.5 m by 2.5 m.
Branches: evenly spaced along the main gallery, square to it; their real places are on the visitor plan, which is not free to copy.
Each branch stops where 1 m of rock still covers its top, to the half metre: the embrasure through the cliff face is not modelled.
Not modelled: the archaeological crypt, the keep, the prison, the well, the siege rooms, the Grund battery, stairs and the lower storeys.
